report.summary: P-D006 (59M, uninsured/self-pay, no transport benefit) needs help with medication cost and transportation. Primary cost barrier: tiotropium brand inhaler $420/month with a 45-day refill gap; albuterol $30 and amlodipine $4 are affordable. CMS screener confirms a transportation need ("no"). Home tract 17031290900 is low-income with 41% of households lacking a vehicle and moderate transit access (36 stops within 800m, 29 with early service). Upcoming primary-care appointment appt:2 on 2026-10-23 at 14:00 at "Clinic" (no facility location on file, so transit feasibility could not be computed). Eligibility assessed where possible.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Short-term copay help for current patients; contact the clinic to apply.

options.name: Rx Bridge Program
options.how_to_access: Free and low-cost medication options for people with chronic illness; inquire about tiotropium assistance.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Help applying for Extra Help and manufacturer patient-assistance programs (note: Extra Help/LIS is generally Medicare-based; patient is 59 and uninsured, so manufacturer programs are the more relevant path).

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days — start well before the 10/23 appointment.

options.name: Rx Bridge Program
options.how_to_access: Also listed under transportation; ask whether it offers ride support for medical visits.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — requires Medicaid plan membership; patient is uninsured.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — free rides for adults 60+; patient is 59.
